corridor_notes: EIA report (南京国环环境科技发展股份有限公司, dated Feb 2013) for '川气东送江苏配套管线一期工程仪扬泰管道工程' (Jiangsu Natural Gas Co. Ltd, Sichuan-East Jiangsu supporting pipeline phase 1, Yiyangtai pipeline) states: '起自江苏省天然气公司仪征青山分输站...止于江都区丁沟分输站' (begins at Jiangsu Natural Gas Co.'s Qingshan Distribution Station in Yizheng, ends at Dingou Distribution Station in Jiangdu District). Total length ~94.9km -- an exact match to GEM's LengthMergedKm (94.90). Segment breakdown given in the source: Yizheng section ~35.5km, Yangzhou section ~30.3km, Jiangdu section ~29.1km (i.e. the route passes through Yizheng city, then Yangzhou proper, then Jiangdu district -- matching GEM's segment name 'Yiyangtai = Yizheng-Yangzhou-Jiangdu'). Main line 88.6km at D813mm/6.3MPa; a 6.3km D323.9mm branch also exists. Three distribution stations and eight isolation valve stations along the route.
researcher_notes: High confidence: exact length match (94.9km) to GEM plus a direct, unambiguous 起点/止点 (start/end) statement naming both distribution stations. This is the cleanest resolution of the five PIDs in this group.
